findings.summary: The current official catalog is broader and location-dependent; a complete national product boundary could not be reconciled from the accessible surfaces without selecting every category and location.

Current official materials do not establish complete contains or may-contain arrays for every current product or frozen group. Explicit positives in the frozen baseline should be independently rechecked, but no negative claims are supported. Global cross-contact warnings apply.

summary: Candidate Luna scout completed after reading the repository instructions, verification plan, job, and all 80 frozen item-check rows. Official current evidence confirms Baskin-Robbins identity and multiple current menu surfaces, but the location-specific ordering catalog and current nutrition PDF reveal catalog drift and incomplete allergen coverage. Terra should independently enumerate every ordering category and reconcile explicit positive allergens without inferring negatives or cross-contact absence.
